title: Prove restored dirty helpers preserve square-zero query capacity (no κ)
body:
## Summary

Prove that arbitrary finite restored dirty workspace cannot improve the exact characteristic-two square-zero query capacity. Claim type: scoped written proof with exact finite corroboration. This answers the dirty-workspace part of Josie Elliston's [#6138, second open question](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6138).

```text
K has characteristic two; Q is a formal central involution
free: constant invertible bases
paid: I+Q N, N^2=0, rank(N)<=r
endpoint on every input: diag(Q I_n,I_h), with arbitrary finite h

k>=3, m_k=2 floor((k-1)/2)
feasible iff n is even and n+ceil(n/m_k)<=k r
when feasible, minimum total paid rank = n+ceil(n/m_k)
```

The new projection-complement argument proves necessity independently of the dirty-helper count. The workspace-free attaining construction is credited to #6138 and used as a cited theorem. It was not replayed as the contribution. Credit Nick Petalas #6122, Cinna Davis's simplex, Ali Romman's #5617 Gram framework and block simplex, and Matarener's #6114 question. This contribution was produced by Nick Petalas. No kappa or selected-frontier change is claimed.

## Evidence

Before, the Gram argument started from an identity endpoint and left dirty workspace open. After, the full arbitrary-input endpoint gives a projection P. Its call Gram complement can have a nonidentity involution core C, with C^2=I. Invertibility of C preserves the sharp even-call rank inequality; a dimension count handles odd call counts.

Local checks on `c94197e40c9e8a25f643d776160659871e5ce9ac` passed with CPython 3.12.15 on macOS arm64:

- Both pair joins and a direct scan of all 234,256 three-coordinate four-tuples find exactly 648 valid dirty-helper words. All new complement identities pass, including 288 nonidentity cores. Literal formal-ring execution checks all eight dirty inputs per word, totaling 5,184 executions.
- Padded projection fixtures exercise call counts three through eight. Four-coordinate two-pair minimization includes all 11,236 cap-one and 99,856 cap-two ordered pairs and gives total-rank minimum three in both cases.
- Four malformed candidates are rejected for their intended reasons; a clean-helper control distinguishes a zero-input promise from full dirty restoration.
- Warning-strict normal and optimized direct commands pass in approximately 0.28 seconds each, with identical generated, source-hash-bound receipts. Both registered commands pass.
- All six committed files pass byte, executable-mode and source-ancestry checks. The official committed export passes input-coverage integrity checking. Both normal and optimized commands pass from the read-only export with Git absent from PATH; all exported input bytes remain unchanged.

Exact reproduction from the repository root:

```sh
/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -I -O -W error -B research/restored-dirty-query-capacity/verify.py

/Users/nick/git/integer-mult-bounds/.venv/bin/python3.12 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/restored-dirty-query-capacity --check-source-history --check-modes
```

Substitute the reviewer's CPython 3.12 path elsewhere. Standard library only. Expected markers are `PASS_RESTORED_DIRTY_QUERY_CAPACITY`, `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE` and `PASS_RESEARCH_COMMIT_BYTES`. The source question and attainment theorem are provenance-pinned on canonical main `7c49fe32c55de02c2c873655c804b16e4c3fef0a`.

## Limitations and unrun obligations

This requires exact formal central-involution equality, constant free controls, square-zero paid terms and complete restoration of all arbitrary dirty helpers. Initialized clean or discarded helpers, non-square-zero paid operations, nonlinear controls and approximation remain outside the theorem. The all-field conclusion has a written proof; finite checks cover only the stated binary domains.

No native multi-bank realization, charged physical bases, full caller invoice, compiler, precision/tape construction, selected cold replay, Lean or Docker run is supplied. The five selected framework assumptions remain. Independent human and formal proof-kernel review are unclaimed.

## Open next questions

- Can initialized clean helpers reduce the floor for even target dimensions? First specify the normalized unspecified helper-column blocks and the exact clean-return contract.
- Can an invertible non-square-zero paid alphabet improve an actual caller? First give one native gate's complete arbitrary-input response and its full rank and cost bill.

## Related open work

- [#6726](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6726) supplies a physical paid-idle-fragmentation caller and a scalar header-query floor. This result closes a distinct abstract restored-dirty-workspace capacity question and makes no invoice comparison.
- [#6735](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6735) studies the rank-one even-controlled header floor and its literal caller phase. This result treats higher-rank square-zero calls with a full projection endpoint; its rank-one special case is not claimed as new.
- [#6768](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6768) studies projection endpoints formed from two capped higher-nilpotency blocks. The present theorem concerns three or more square-zero query terms and exact dirty-helper restoration.
- [#6797](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/6797) classifies saturated two-cubic-nilpotent projection sums. This proof uses a projection-complement involution for square-zero terms; it does not compute or compare cubic equality counts.

The completion refresh inspected the nine other open PRs from this account created since the advance CLAIM: #6795, #6796, #6797, #6798, #6799, #6801, #6802, #6803 and #6804. The adjacent cubic projection-sum result #6797 is already distinguished above. The other results concern padding tapes, balanced dirty-word intervals, cube lattices, temporal rank chains, signed halves, NTT arithmetic, singleton returns and owner-route graphs. None computes a competing square-zero dirty-workspace capacity. No additional computation replayed another contribution.

No registered check remains pending. CI corroborates the declared finite replay; independent human and formal proof-kernel review remain unclaimed.

## Merge danger

Two-way door. Blast radius: isolated research package. The change adds six files and does not alter shared code, frozen predecessors or selected results.
